subject.title: fix(ai): remove Windows path heuristic that double-escapes JSON newlines

question: Should OpenClaw continue recovering malformed Windows-path escapes from model-emitted tool JSON, or intentionally retire that compatibility behavior to prioritize valid JSON newline escapes?
rationale: The two inputs are indistinguishable in this context-free repair function, and the PR changes current behavior rather than implementing an unambiguous bug fix.

options.title: Preserve malformed-path compatibility
options.body: Keep a tested recovery path and move the newline-regression fix to a layer with enough tool-argument context.

options.title: Retire recovery deliberately
options.body: Accept malformed Windows paths as unsupported model output, with explicit maintainer approval, upgrade documentation, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Leave the current compatibility behavior in place until a parser-boundary design can support both cases safely.

recommendation.title: Preserve malformed-path compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep a tested recovery path and move the newline-regression fix to a layer with enough tool-argument context.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct context on the competing branch implementations, though a current-main feature owner should confirm the product contract.
